name: Torg Eternity decks
description: A Destiny deck with card names from memory, and a stand-in Drama deck. Neither is the published deck: check them against your Torg Eternity cards.

entities.name: Destiny deck
entities.description: Card names from memory, one copy each: the real deck has more cards and several copies of many of them. The text is on your Torg Eternity cards. For a deck of your own, make one under Library, Decks.

entities.name: Drama deck
entities.description: Not the published Drama deck: 40 cards made from the parts Drama cards have (who goes first and the conditions for heroes and villains in standard and dramatic conflicts, approved actions, and a dramatic skill resolution step), mixed at random. Use it if you have no Drama deck at hand. The gamemaster flips one to the table each round. For your own deck, make one under Library, Decks.
